caption: Villa d'Este, Tivoli
composition: Terraced Renaissance gardens and fountain axes · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the upper terrace the tourist looks down the famous water axis, where fountains and cascades step through clipped hedges toward a jetting basin center-right. Tall dark cypresses and umbrella pines frame the scene, with the villa's pale walls at the left edge and mist lying in the valley beyond to the right. The 07:42 sun gilds the treetops while the garden terraces still hold cool morning shadow.
